name: Ab Roll Workout
cues: Kneel on the floor and grip an ab wheel or barbell with both hands, shoulder-width apart.
Position the wheel directly beneath your shoulders with your arms fully extended.
Slowly roll the wheel forward, extending your body towards the ground while keeping your core tight.
Pause when your body is nearly parallel to the floor, then engage your abs to roll back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Cable Crunch (Kneeling)
cues: Attach a rope handle to the high pulley of a cable machine and kneel on the floor facing away from the machine.
Grasp the rope with both hands and bring your hands down to the sides of your head or neck, keeping your elbows bent.
Engage your core and crunch your torso forward and downward, bringing your elbows towards your knees.
Pause at the bottom of the movement, squeezing your abdominal muscles.
Slowly control the weight as you raise your torso back to the starting upright kneeling position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Captain'S Chair Leg Raises
cues: Mount a captain's chair apparatus and grip the handles firmly with your arms bent at 90 degrees.
Allow your legs to hang straight down and engage your core.
Keeping your legs together, raise them upward until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Pause briefly at the top, then slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions without swinging your body.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
cues: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms fully extended and feet off the floor.
Engage your core and keep your body stable to minimize swinging.
Raise your legs upward by flexing at the hips, keeping your legs straight or slightly bent.
Continue lifting until your legs are parallel to the floor or higher if flexibility allows.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Kettlebell Sit-Ups To Press
cues: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, holding a kettlebell at chest level with both hands.
Engage your core and perform a full sit-up, rising to an upright seated position.
At the top of the sit-up, press the kettlebell overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the kettlebell back to your chest and slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Plank Hold Weighted
cues: Place a weight plate on your upper back and assume a forearm plank position with your elbows directly beneath your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels, engaging your core and glutes.
Maintain a neutral spine and avoid letting your hips sag or rise.
Hold the position for the desired duration while breathing steadily.
Carefully remove the weight and rest before repeating.

name: Russian Twist Weighted
cues: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet slightly elevated, holding a weight plate or dumbbell with both hands.
Lean back slightly to create tension in your core, keeping your spine straight.
Rotate your torso to the right, bringing the weight towards the floor beside your hip.
Return to center and rotate to the left, repeating the movement on the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Band Pushups
cues: Loop a resistance band across your upper back and hold each end in your hands, placing your palms flat on the floor.
Position yourself in a standard push-up stance with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lower your chest towards the floor by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position, working against the band resistance.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Curl Standard
cues: Stand upright holding a barbell with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary.
Curl the barbell upward by contracting your biceps until the bar is at shoulder level.
Pause at the top of the movement and squeeze your biceps.
Slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Hold
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a loaded barbell at your sides with an overhand grip.
Allow your arms to hang straight down, fully extending your fingers around the bar.
Squeeze the bar as hard as possible and hold for the desired duration.
Focus on maintaining grip strength without bending your arms.
Set the bar down in a controlled manner and rest before repeating.

name: Cable Curl (Straight Bar)
cues: Attach a straight bar to the low pulley of a cable machine and stand facing the machine.
Grasp the bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart, and keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar upward by contracting your biceps until your forearms are parallel to the floor.
Pause at the top and squeeze your biceps, then slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Cable Wood Chop
cues: Attach a single handle to the high pulley of a cable machine and stand sideways to the machine.
Grip the handle with both hands and position your feet shoulder-width apart.
In one sweeping motion, pull the handle diagonally downward across your body towards the opposite hip, rotating your torso.
Control the movement as you return the handle to the starting position.
Complete all repetitions on one side before switching.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press Barbell
cues: Lie flat on a bench and grip a barbell with your hands approximately shoulder-width apart or slightly closer.
Unrack the bar and hold it directly above your chest with your arms fully extended.
Lower the bar to your lower chest by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Press the bar back up to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Concentration Curl (Seated)
cues: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and a dumbbell in one hand.
Rest the back of your upper arm against the inside of your thigh for support.
Curl the dumbbell upward towards your shoulder by contracting your bicep.
Pause at the top of the movement and squeeze your bicep.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position and repeat, then switch arms.

name: Dumbbell Curl
cues: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging by your sides and palms facing forward.
Keep your upper arms stationary and close to your torso.
Curl the dumbbells upward by contracting your biceps until they reach shoulder level.
Pause at the top and squeeze your biceps, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
cues: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip, palms facing your torso.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary.
Curl the dumbbells upward while maintaining the neutral grip, bringing them to shoulder level.
Pause at the top and squeeze your biceps and forearms.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Press Version 1
cues: Sit on a bench with back support and hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Keep your feet flat on the floor and your back pressed against the pad.
Press the dumbbells upward and slightly inward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause briefly at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Spider Curl
cues: Set an incline bench to approximately 45 degrees and lie face down with your chest against the pad.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging straight down and palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells upward by contracting your biceps, keeping your upper arms perpendicular to the floor.
Pause at the top of the movement and squeeze your biceps.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
cues: Sit on an incline bench set to approximately 60 degrees and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Allow your arms to hang straight down behind the plane of your body, fully stretching the biceps.
Curl the dumbbells upward by contracting your biceps while keeping your upper arms stationary.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Landmine Press (Single Arm)
cues: Secure one end of a barbell into a landmine attachment or wedge it into a corner.
Stand facing the barbell and grasp the free end with one hand at shoulder height.
Stagger your stance for balance and keep your core braced.
Press the barbell upward and forward in an arcing motion until your arm is fully extended.
Slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position and repeat, then switch arms.

name: Overhead Triceps Extension (Dumbbell)
cues: Stand or sit upright and hold a single dumbbell with both hands, gripping the top plate.
Raise the dumbbell overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms close to your head and elbows pointing forward, lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Pause at the bottom, then extend your arms back to the starting position by contracting your triceps.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Preacher Curl Ez Bar
cues: Sit at a preacher curl bench and place the back of your upper arms flat against the angled pad.
Grip an ez curl bar with an underhand grip using the inner angled handles.
Starting with your arms nearly fully extended, curl the bar upward by contracting your biceps.
Pause at the top of the movement and squeeze your biceps.
Slowly lower the bar back to the near-extended starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Single Arm Straight Arm Cable Pulldown
cues: Attach a single handle to the high pulley of a cable machine.
Stand facing the machine and grasp the handle with one hand using a neutral grip.
Lean slightly forward with your arm extended overhead and maintain a slight bend in your elbow.
Keeping your arm nearly straight, pull the handle down in an arc toward your hip by contracting your lats.
Pause briefly at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position under control.
Complete all repetitions on one side before switching arms.

name: Skull Crushers (Ez Bar)
cues: Lie flat on a bench and hold an ez curl bar with an overhand grip, arms extended directly above your chest.
Keeping your upper arms vertical and elbows pointing toward the ceiling, slowly lower the bar toward your forehead.
Pause just above your forehead, then extend your arms back to the starting position by contracting your triceps.
Keep your elbows tucked and avoid flaring them outward throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Triceps Pushdown (Cable - Straight Bar)
cues: Attach a straight bar to the high pulley of a cable machine and stand facing the machine.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart, and tuck your elbows close to your sides.
Push the bar downward by extending your arms until they are fully straight.
Pause at the bottom and squeeze your triceps.
Slowly allow the bar to rise back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Weighted Push Up
cues: Place a weight plate on your upper back and assume a standard push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels and engage your core.
Lower your chest towards the floor by bending your elbows, keeping them at approximately 45 degrees from your body.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Wide Dumbbell Push Up
cues: Place two dumbbells on the floor wider than shoulder-width apart and grip each handle.
Assume a push-up position with your arms fully extended, hands gripping the dumbbells.
Lower your chest towards the floor between the dumbbells by bending your elbows.
Push through the dumbbells to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining a straight body line throughout.

name: Barbell Bent Over Row
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Hinge at the hips to lean your torso forward to approximately 45 degrees, keeping your back flat.
Let the barbell hang with your arms extended, then row it upward towards your lower chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Shrug
cues: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
Allow your arms to hang straight down, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Elevate your shoulders as high as possible towards your ears in a shrugging motion.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your traps.
Slowly lower your shoulders back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Cable Face Pull
cues: Attach a rope handle to a cable machine set at approximately face height and stand facing the machine.
Grip the rope with both hands using an overhand grip and step back until your arms are extended.
Pull the rope towards your face by driving your elbows outward and back.
Separate the rope ends at your face level, bringing your hands to either side of your head.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Chin Up Leg Folded
cues: Hang from a pull-up bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Cross your ankles and bend your knees to bring your legs up behind you in a folded position.
Engage your core and pull your body upward until your chin clears the bar.
Pause at the top, squeezing your lats and biceps.
Slowly lower yourself back to the hanging position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Deadlift Barbell
cues: Stand with feet hip-width apart and a loaded barbell over your mid-foot.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to grip the bar with hands just outside your legs.
Take a deep breath, brace your core, and keep your chest up with a flat back.
Drive through your heels to lift the barbell, extending your hips and knees simultaneously.
Stand tall at the top, then hinge at the hips and bend your knees to lower the bar back to the floor in a controlled manner.

name: Deadlift Sumo Barbell
cues: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width apart with toes pointed outward, and a barbell over your mid-foot.
Grip the bar with hands inside your legs using an overhand or mixed grip.
Brace your core and keep your chest up, then push your knees out in line with your toes.
Drive through your heels to lift the bar, extending your hips and knees at the same rate.
Stand fully upright at the top, then lower the bar back to the floor in a controlled manner.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
cues: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with a neutral grip.
Allow your arms to hang straight down with your shoulders relaxed.
Elevate your shoulders as high as possible towards your ears in a controlled shrugging motion.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your trapezius muscles.
Slowly lower your shoulders back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Good Morning Barbell
cues: Place a barbell across your upper traps as if performing a back squat and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
With your knees slightly bent, hinge forward at the hips, pushing them back as you lower your torso.
Continue lowering until your torso is approximately parallel to the floor or until you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings.
Pause at the bottom, then drive your hips forward to return to the upright starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Hyperextensions (Back Extensions)
cues: Position yourself face down on a hyperextension bench with your hips at the edge of the pad and feet secured.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands behind your head.
Lower your torso toward the floor in a controlled manner, bending at the waist.
Raise your torso back up by contracting your lower back and glutes until your body forms a straight line.
Pause at the top and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Lat Pull Down Wide Grip
cues: Sit at a lat pulldown machine and grip the bar with an overhand grip wider than shoulder-width apart.
Adjust the knee pad to secure your legs and lean back slightly.
Pull the bar downward towards your upper chest by driving your elbows down and back.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly allow the bar to rise back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Pull Up
cues: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and avoid swinging your body.
Pull yourself upward by driving your elbows down and back until your chin clears the bar.
Pause at the top and squeeze your lats.
Slowly lower yourself back to the full hanging position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Rear Delt Fly With Dumbbell
cues: Sit on the edge of a bench and hinge forward at the hips with your chest near your thighs.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip, allowing them to hang below your knees.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arcing motion, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause at the top when your arms are parallel to the floor.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Seated Chest Supported Machine
cues: Sit facing a chest-supported row machine and press your chest firmly against the pad.
Grip the handles with both hands using a neutral or overhand grip.
Pull the handles back towards your body by retracting your shoulder blades and driving your elbows back.
Pause at the peak of the contraction, squeezing your lats and rhomboids.
Slowly release the handles back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: T-Bar Row
cues: Load one end of a barbell into a landmine attachment and straddle the bar.
Grip the bar end with both hands using a neutral grip handle or cupping the plates.
Hinge at the hips to lean your torso forward at approximately 45 degrees, keeping your back flat.
Row the bar upward towards your chest by driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades.
Slowly lower the bar back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Bench Press Flat
cues: Lie flat on a bench and grip the barbell with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and hold it directly above your chest with your arms fully extended.
Lower the bar to your mid-chest by bending your elbows at approximately 45 degrees.
Press the bar back up to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Incline Bench Press
cues: Set an incline bench to 30-45 degrees and lie back, gripping the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar and hold it above your upper chest with arms extended.
Lower the bar to your upper chest in a controlled manner.
Press the bar back up to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: High To Low Cable Crossover
cues: Set both cable pulleys to the highest position and attach a single handle to each side.
Stand between the pulleys, grasp a handle in each hand, and step forward into a staggered stance.
Lean slightly forward with a slight bend in your elbows and keep your chest lifted.
Bring the handles downward and inward in a wide arc until they meet in front of your lower chest or hips.
Squeeze your chest at the bottom of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position under control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dips (Chest Focus - Leaning Forward)
cues: Grip the parallel bars of a dip station and lift yourself up to the starting position with arms extended.
Lean your torso forward at approximately 30-45 degrees and allow your elbows to flare slightly outward.
Lower yourself by bending your elbows until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press (Bench)
cues: Lie flat on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at chest level, palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended above your chest.
Lower the dumbbells back to chest level in a controlled arc, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Pause briefly at the bottom, then press back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press (Decline)
cues: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured at the top and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Begin with the dumbbells at chest level, palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press Incline
cues: Lie on an incline bench set to 30-45 degrees and hold a dumbbell in each hand at chest level.
Press the dumbbells upward and slightly inward until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the dumbbells back to chest level in a controlled arc.
Pause briefly at the bottom, then press back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Flys Flat
cues: Lie flat on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms extended directly above your chest.
With a slight bend in your elbows, lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc.
Continue lowering until you feel a deep stretch across your chest.
Reverse the motion and bring the dumbbells back up in the same arcing path until they meet above your chest.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Flys Incline
cues: Lie on an incline bench set to 30-45 degrees holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
With a slight bend in your elbows, lower the dumbbells outward in a wide arc.
Continue lowering until you feel a deep stretch in your upper chest.
Bring the dumbbells back up in the same arcing motion to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Pec Deck Machine Fly
cues: Sit on the pec deck machine and adjust the seat so your arms are parallel to the floor.
Place your forearms against the arm pads or grip the handles with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
Press the arm pads together in front of your chest by contracting your pectoral muscles.
Pause at the peak of the contraction and squeeze your chest.
Slowly allow the arm pads to return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Svend Press Chest
cues: Stand upright and hold a pair of weight plates pressed together at chest level with both palms.
Press the plates outward from your chest until your arms are nearly fully extended.
Squeeze the plates together throughout the entire movement to engage the inner chest.
Slowly pull the plates back towards your chest in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Air Bike Sprint
cues: Sit on the air bike and adjust the seat so your legs are slightly bent at full extension.
Grip the moving handles with both hands.
Begin pedaling and pumping the handles simultaneously at maximum effort.
Sprint at full intensity for the desired interval duration.
Slow down gradually and rest before repeating.

name: Barbell Back Squat
cues: Position a barbell on your upper traps and step back from the rack with feet shoulder-width apart.
Point your toes slightly outward and keep your chest up and core braced.
Descend by bending your knees and pushing your hips back until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to extend your knees and hips and return to the standing position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat
cues: Stand in front of a bench and hold a barbell across your upper traps.
Extend one leg behind you and rest the top of your foot on the bench.
Lower your back knee toward the floor by bending your front knee, keeping your torso upright.
Descend until your front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Drive through your front heel to return to the starting position and repeat, then switch legs.

name: Barbell Front Squat
cues: Position a barbell in a front rack across the front of your shoulders with your elbows raised high.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly pointed out.
Keeping your elbows high and torso upright, descend by bending your knees and hips.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the floor or below.
Drive through your heels to return to the standing position and repeat.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
cues: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell across your hips.
Plant your feet flat on the floor hip-width apart with knees bent.
Drive through your heels to thrust your hips upward until your body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement.
Lower your hips back toward the floor in a controlled manner and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell March
cues: Hold a barbell across your upper traps as in a back squat position with feet hip-width apart.
Brace your core and maintain an upright posture.
Lift one knee upward to hip height in a marching motion while keeping your stance foot flat.
Lower your foot and repeat the movement with the opposite leg.
Continue alternating legs in a controlled marching motion for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Reverse Lunges
cues: Stand upright with a barbell across your upper traps and feet together.
Step one foot directly backward and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Continue descending until your front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Push through your front heel to bring your back foot forward to the starting position.
Alternate legs for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
cues: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
Keep a soft bend in your knees and your back flat throughout the movement.
Hinge at the hips and push them back as you lower the bar along your legs.
Continue lowering until you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to return to the upright position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Cable Leg Kickback
cues: Attach an ankle strap to the low pulley of a cable machine and secure it to one ankle.
Face the machine and hold the frame for support, keeping your body slightly inclined.
Keeping your knee straight, kick your strapped leg backward and upward as far as possible.
Squeeze your glute at the top of the movement.
Slowly return your leg to the starting position and repeat, then switch legs.

name: Cycling
cues: Mount a stationary bike and adjust the seat height so your leg has a slight bend at full pedal extension.
Place your feet in the pedal straps and grip the handlebars.
Begin pedaling at a comfortable cadence, maintaining an upright or forward-leaning posture.
Adjust the resistance as needed to reach your target intensity level.
Continue for the desired duration, then gradually slow to a cool down pace.

name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
cues: Stand in front of a bench and hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Extend one leg back and rest the top of your foot on the bench.
Lower your back knee toward the floor by bending your front knee.
Descend until your front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Drive through your front heel to return to the starting position and repeat, then switch legs.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a dumbbell vertically at chest level with both hands cupping the top end.
Keep your elbows tucked in and your chest up.
Descend into a squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to return to the standing position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Hip Hinge
cues: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your knees and your back flat throughout the movement.
Hinge at the hips and push them back as you lower your torso toward the floor.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then drive your hips forward to return to standing.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Jump Squat
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Perform a squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back to thigh-parallel depth.
Explosively drive through your heels to jump off the ground as high as possible.
Land softly with bent knees to absorb the impact.
Immediately descend into the next squat and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Elliptical Hiit Machine
cues: Step onto the elliptical machine and grip the moving handles.
Set a high resistance level appropriate for interval training.
Push and pull the handles while driving through the pedals at maximum effort for the work interval.
Reduce your pace to a slow recovery stride for the rest interval.
Continue alternating between work and rest intervals for the desired duration.

name: Hack Squat Machine
cues: Position yourself on the hack squat machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the shoulder pads.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform with toes slightly pointed out.
Release the safety handles and lower the sled by bending your knees to 90 degrees or below.
Drive through your heels to extend your knees and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Hip Abduction Machine
cues: Sit on the hip abduction machine with your outer thighs resting against the padded levers.
Adjust the starting position so your legs are together and feet are flat on the foot rests.
Push your legs outward against the resistance by abducting your hips as far as comfortable.
Pause at the end of the range of motion, then slowly return your legs to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Kettlebell Hold March
cues: Stand upright holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
Brace your core and maintain an upright posture with shoulders back.
Lift one knee upward to hip height in a controlled marching motion.
Lower that foot to the floor and immediately lift the opposite knee.
Continue alternating legs in a slow, deliberate march for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Kettlebell Lift Up
cues: Stand with feet hip-width apart and a kettlebell on the floor between your feet.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to grip the kettlebell handle with both hands.
Brace your core and maintain a flat back as you prepare to lift.
Drive through your heels and extend your hips and knees to stand upright, lifting the kettlebell.
Lower the kettlebell back to the floor in a controlled manner and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Swing
cues: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width and the kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge at the hips to grip the kettlebell with both hands and hike it back between your legs.
Explosively drive your hips forward to propel the kettlebell upward to chest or shoulder height.
Allow the kettlebell to swing back down and hike it back between your legs, hinging at the hips.
Repeat the swing in a fluid, continuous motion for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Leg Extension Machine
cues: Sit on the leg extension machine and adjust the back pad so your knees align with the machine's pivot point.
Place your shins behind the padded lever and grip the handles at your sides.
Extend your legs upward by straightening your knees until your legs are parallel to the floor.
Pause at the top and squeeze your quadriceps.
Slowly lower the lever back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Leg Press Machine
cues: Sit on the leg press machine and place your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Release the safety handles and lower the platform by bending your knees toward your chest.
Stop when your knees reach approximately 90 degrees or your lower back begins to lift off the seat.
Drive through your heels to extend your knees and push the platform back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Lying Leg Curl Machine
cues: Lie face down on the leg curl machine and position the pad just above your heels.
Grip the handles beneath the bench for stability.
Curl your heels toward your glutes by bending your knees as far as the machine allows.
Pause at the top and squeeze your hamstrings.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Rope Wave
cues: Hold one end of a battle rope in each hand and stand in a half-squat position.
Brace your core and keep your feet shoulder-width apart.
Rapidly raise and lower one arm while the other arm descends, creating alternating waves in the rope.
Maintain a continuous, powerful wave motion for the desired interval duration.
Rest and repeat for the desired number of sets.

name: Rowing Machine
cues: Sit on the rowing machine, secure your feet in the straps, and grip the handle with both hands.
Begin with your knees bent, leaning slightly forward, and arms extended.
Drive through your legs to extend your knees while simultaneously leaning back slightly.
As your legs reach full extension, pull the handle toward your lower chest by bending your elbows.
Reverse the sequence to return to the starting position and repeat for the desired duration.

name: Run On Treadmill
cues: Step onto the treadmill and set your desired speed and incline level.
Begin walking and gradually increase the speed to your running pace.
Maintain an upright posture with a slight forward lean and land softly on your midfoot.
Swing your arms in coordination with your legs to maintain rhythm.
Continue running for the desired duration, then gradually decrease speed to a walking cool down.

name: Seated Leg Curl Machine
cues: Sit on the seated leg curl machine and adjust the back pad so your knees align with the pivot point.
Place your legs over the top pad and secure the lower pad just above your ankles.
Curl your legs downward by bending your knees as far as the machine allows.
Pause at the bottom and squeeze your hamstrings.
Slowly return your legs to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Seated Overhead Press
cues: Sit on a shoulder press machine and adjust the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
Grip the handles with both hands and plant your feet flat on the floor.
Press the handles upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause briefly at the top, then slowly lower the handles back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Step-Ups (Weighted)
cues: Stand in front of a box or bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot up onto the surface and drive through that heel to lift your body up.
Bring your back foot up to stand fully on the box.
Step the leading foot back down to the floor followed by the trailing foot.
Alternate the leading leg or complete all repetitions on one side before switching.

name: Stepmill Machine Version 1
cues: Step onto the stepmill machine and grip the handrails lightly for balance.
Set your desired speed on the control panel.
Begin stepping at a comfortable pace, placing your full foot on each step.
Drive through your heel with each step to engage your glutes and quads.
Continue for the desired duration, maintaining an upright posture and minimizing reliance on the handrails.

name: Stepmill Machine
cues: Mount the stepmill and set your target speed and duration.
Step onto the rotating staircase and begin climbing at a steady pace.
Keep your torso upright and engage your core throughout the exercise.
Drive through each step using your full foot to activate the glutes and quads.
Complete the session for the desired duration, then slow down to cool off before dismounting.

name: Stiff-Legged Deadlift Machine
cues: Stand on the platform of a deadlift machine with feet hip-width apart and grip the handles.
Keep your legs nearly straight with a slight bend in your knees.
Hinge at the hips and lower the handles along your legs until you feel a deep hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to return to the upright starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Triceps Pushdown (Cable - Rope)
cues: Attach a rope handle to the high pulley of a cable machine and stand facing the machine.
Grasp the rope with both hands using a neutral grip and tuck your elbows close to your sides.
Push the rope downward by extending your arms until they are fully straight.
At the bottom, spread the rope ends apart slightly to maximize tricep contraction.
Slowly allow the rope to rise back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Walk On Treadmill
cues: Step onto the treadmill and set a comfortable walking speed and incline.
Begin walking at your chosen pace, maintaining an upright posture.
Swing your arms naturally in coordination with your stride.
Keep your gaze forward and avoid looking down at your feet.
Continue walking for the desired duration, then gradually bring the belt to a stop.

name: Arnold Press Dumbbell
cues: Sit on a bench with back support and hold a dumbbell in each hand at chest height, palms facing you.
Begin the press by rotating your palms to face forward as you push the dumbbells upward.
Continue pressing until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Reverse the motion, rotating your palms back to face you as you lower the dumbbells to chest height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Overhead Press Standing
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
Brace your core and maintain a neutral spine throughout the movement.
Press the barbell directly overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Upright Row
cues: Stand upright holding a barbell with an overhand grip, hands approximately shoulder-width apart.
Let the bar hang in front of your thighs with your arms extended.
Pull the bar upward along your body by raising your elbows above the level of your hands.
Continue pulling until the bar reaches chin height and your elbows are above your shoulders.
Slowly lower the bar back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Standard
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Brace your core and maintain an upright posture.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause briefly at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
cues: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip in front of your thighs.
Pull the dumbbells upward along your body by raising your elbows above the level of your hands.
Continue pulling until the dumbbells reach chest height and your elbows are at shoulder level.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Front Raise (Dumbbell)
cues: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs with palms facing your body.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and your back straight.
Raise one or both dumbbells forward and upward until your arms are parallel to the floor.
Pause briefly at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Front Raise (Weighted Plate)
cues: Stand upright and hold a weight plate with both hands at the 3 and 9 o'clock positions in front of your thighs.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and your core engaged.
Raise the plate forward and upward in a controlled arc until your arms are parallel to the floor.
Pause briefly at the top, then slowly lower the plate back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Kettlebell Overhead Press
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a kettlebell in one hand at shoulder height in the rack position.
Brace your core and keep your elbow pointing forward.
Press the kettlebell straight overhead until your arm is fully extended.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower the kettlebell back to the rack position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.

name: Cable Cross Lateral Raise
cues: Stand between two low cable pulleys and grasp the opposite handle with each hand so the cables cross in front of your body.
Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart, keep your core braced, and maintain a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise both arms out to your sides until they are approximately parallel to the floor.
Pause briefly at the top while squeezing your lateral deltoids.
Slowly lower the handles back to the starting position under control and repeat.

name: Lateral Raises (Dumbbell)
cues: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with a neutral grip.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and your core engaged.
Raise both dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until your arms are parallel to the floor.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your medial delts.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Lateral Raise Machine
cues: Stand on the platform of the lateral raise machine and position your upper arms against the pads.
Keep your chest up, core engaged, and maintain a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise the pads outward by abducting your shoulders until your upper arms are approximately parallel to the floor.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your lateral deltoids.
Slowly lower the weight back to the starting position under control and repeat.

name: Military Press (Seated - Smith Machine)
cues: Set a bench inside a smith machine and adjust the bar to shoulder height.
Sit on the bench and grip the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar and hold it at the front of your shoulders.
Press the bar upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Slowly lower the bar back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Rear Delt Fly (Reverse Pec Deck)
cues: Sit facing the pec deck machine and adjust the seat so your arms are parallel to the floor.
Grip the handles with a neutral grip and keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the handles outward and backward in a wide arcing motion by squeezing your rear delts and shoulder blades together.
Pause at the peak of the contraction.
Slowly return the handles to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Rear Delt Cable Fly
cues: Stand between two cable pulleys set at shoulder height.
Grasp the opposite cable handle with each hand and step back until there is tension on the cables.
Maintain a slight bend in your elbows and keep your chest up throughout the movement.
Pull your arms outward and backward in a wide arc until they are in line with your shoulders.
Squeeze your rear delts and upper back at the end of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position under control and repeat.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout (Kneeling)
cues: Kneel on the floor and grip an ab wheel with both hands directly below your shoulders.
Engage your core and slowly roll the wheel forward, extending your body toward the ground.
Continue rolling until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor without touching it.
Pause briefly, then use your abs to pull the wheel back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Assisted Pull Up
cues: Set the desired counterweight on the assisted pull-up machine and kneel or stand on the platform.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your body upward until your chin rises above the bar.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Slowly lower yourself back to the starting position with full arm extension.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Cable Crunch
cues: Attach a rope to the high pulley of a cable machine and kneel facing the machine.
Hold the rope behind your head with both hands and position your hips back slightly.
Engage your core and curl your torso downward, bringing your elbows toward your knees.
Pause at the bottom of the movement, fully contracting your abs.
Slowly return to the starting position, keeping tension on the cable throughout.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Cross-Body Mountain Climbers
cues: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and body in a straight line.
Engage your core and drive your right knee toward your left elbow.
Return your right foot to the starting position, then immediately drive your left knee toward your right elbow.
Continue alternating sides in a controlled, rhythmic motion.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions or duration.

name: Dead Bug
cues: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended straight toward the ceiling and knees bent at 90 degrees above your hips.
Engage your core, pressing your lower back firmly into the floor.
Slowly lower your right arm overhead and extend your left leg toward the floor simultaneously.
Pause just above the floor, then return to the starting position.
Repeat on the opposite side, lowering your left arm and right leg.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Decline Bench Crunch
cues: Position yourself on a decline bench with your feet secured under the pads and hands placed behind your head.
Engage your core and curl your upper body upward toward your knees.
Pause at the top of the movement, fully contracting your abs.
Slowly lower your torso back to the starting position without fully relaxing your core.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Decline Elbow Plank
cues: Place your forearms on the floor and position your feet on an elevated surface such as a bench.
Align your body in a straight line from head to heels, engaging your core fully.
Keep your hips level and avoid raising or dropping your lower back.
Hold this position for the desired duration.
Rest and repeat for the desired number of sets.

name: Dumbbell Chopper
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a dumbbell with both hands.
Raise the dumbbell diagonally overhead to one side, rotating your torso slightly.
In a controlled chopping motion, bring the dumbbell diagonally down toward the opposite hip, rotating your torso.
Pause at the bottom of the movement, then return to the starting position.
Complete the desired number of repetitions on one side before switching.

name: Dumbbell Drag
cues: Start in a high plank position with a dumbbell placed outside your right hand.
Engage your core and keep your hips level throughout the movement.
Reach under your body with your left hand and drag the dumbbell to the left side.
Return your left hand to the plank position and stabilize.
Repeat in the opposite direction, dragging the dumbbell back with your right hand.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Flutter Kick
cues: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and hands placed beneath your lower back for support.
Lift both legs a few inches off the ground, engaging your core.
Alternately raise and lower each leg in a small, controlled fluttering motion.
Keep your lower back pressed toward the floor throughout the movement.
Continue for the desired duration or number of repetitions.

name: Glute Bridge
cues: Lie flat on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides.
Engage your core and press through your heels to lift your hips off the ground.
Drive your hips upward until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Pause at the top, squeezing your glutes tightly.
Slowly lower your hips back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Half Reverse Crunch
cues: Lie flat on your back with your hands placed beneath your lower back and legs bent at 90 degrees.
Engage your core and slowly draw your knees toward your chest, lifting your hips slightly off the floor.
Pause at the top of the movement, contracting your abs.
Slowly lower your legs back to the 90-degree starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Half Sit Ups
cues: Lie flat on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and hands placed behind your head.
Engage your core and curl your upper body upward until your torso reaches a 45-degree angle.
Pause briefly at the halfway point, keeping your lower back in contact with the floor.
Slowly lower your torso back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Hanging Knee Raise (Captain'S Chair)
cues: Position yourself on a captain's chair with your forearms resting on the pads and your back against the support.
Hang freely with your legs extended downward.
Engage your core and raise your knees upward toward your chest.
Pause at the top of the movement, squeezing your abs.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
cues: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms fully extended and legs together.
Engage your core and keep a slight bend in your knees throughout the movement.
Raise your straight legs upward until they are parallel to the floor or higher.
Pause at the top, contracting your abs fully.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position without swinging.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Hollow Body Hold
cues: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back firmly into the floor and engage your core.
Lift your shoulders, arms, and legs a few inches off the ground simultaneously.
Create a banana-like curve in your body while keeping your lower back in contact with the floor.
Hold this position for the desired duration, breathing steadily.
Rest and repeat for the desired number of sets.

name: Jumping Jack
cues: Stand upright with your feet together and arms at your sides.
Jump and simultaneously spread your feet wider than shoulder-width while raising both arms overhead.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with your arms above your head.
Immediately jump again, returning your feet together and arms back to your sides.
Continue at a steady rhythm for the desired number of repetitions or duration.

name: Kneeling Cable Crunch
cues: Attach a rope to the high pulley of a cable machine and kneel facing the machine.
Hold the rope behind your neck with both hands and position your hips back over your heels.
Engage your core and crunch downward, bringing your elbows toward the floor.
Pause at the fully contracted position, isolating the abs.
Slowly return to the upright starting position while maintaining tension on the cable.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Mountain Climber
cues: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly below your shoulders and body in a straight line.
Engage your core and drive your right knee toward your chest.
Quickly return your right foot to the starting position and simultaneously drive your left knee toward your chest.
Continue alternating legs in a running-like motion at a controlled or fast pace.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions or duration.

name: Plank Hip Dip
cues: Start in a forearm plank position with your elbows beneath your shoulders and body in a straight line.
Engage your core and slowly rotate your hips to the right, dipping toward the floor.
Return to the center plank position before dipping your hips to the left.
Continue alternating sides in a smooth, controlled motion.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions or duration.

name: Russian Twist Dumbbell
cues: Sit on the floor with knees bent, feet slightly elevated, and lean back to a 45-degree angle.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to the right, bringing the dumbbell beside your right hip.
Return to center and rotate to the left, bringing the dumbbell beside your left hip.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Russian Twist
cues: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet slightly off the ground.
Lean back slightly to a 45-degree angle, keeping your back straight.
Clasp your hands together in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to the right as far as comfortable, then return to center.
Rotate to the left and return to center.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Scissor Kick
cues: Lie flat on your back with legs extended and hands placed beneath your lower back for support.
Lift both legs a few inches off the floor and engage your core.
Raise your right leg upward while lowering your left leg, then switch in a scissoring motion.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor and your legs as straight as possible.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions or duration.

name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
cues: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart.
Extend one leg straight, keeping your thighs parallel.
Engage your core and press through the heel of the grounded foot to lift your hips.
Raise your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to the raised knee.
Pause at the top, squeezing your glute, then slowly lower your hips back down.
Complete the desired repetitions on one side before switching.

name: Standard Crunch
cues: Lie flat on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and hands placed lightly behind your head.
Engage your core and curl your upper body off the floor toward your knees.
Pause at the top of the movement, contracting your abs.
Slowly lower your upper body back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Standard Plank
cues: Place your forearms on the ground with elbows directly below your shoulders.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on the balls of your feet.
Align your body in a straight line from head to heels, engaging your core.
Keep your hips level and avoid sagging or raising your lower back.
Hold this position for the desired duration.
Rest and repeat for the desired number of sets.

name: Toe Touch Crunch
cues: Lie flat on your back and raise your legs straight up perpendicular to the floor.
Extend your arms toward the ceiling.
Engage your core and reach your hands toward your feet by lifting your shoulders off the ground.
Pause at the top of the movement, contracting your abs.
Slowly lower your upper body back to the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: V-Up
cues: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Simultaneously lift your legs and upper body off the ground, reaching your hands toward your feet.
Form a V-shape with your body at the top of the movement.
Pause briefly, then slowly lower both your arms and legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms fully extended at your sides.
Keeping your elbow stationary, curl the right dumbbell upward toward your shoulder.
Pause at the top and squeeze your bicep, then slowly lower the weight.
Repeat the movement with your left arm.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Archer Push Up
cues: Start in a wide push-up position with your hands significantly wider than shoulder-width.
Extend one arm straight out to the side, parallel to the ground.
Lower your body toward the bent arm, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Push back up to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, extending the opposite arm.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dynamic Overhead Arm Sweep
cues: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms resting naturally at your sides.
Engage your core and maintain a straight posture.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, slowly sweep both arms out to the sides and upward in a wide arc.
Continue raising your arms until they are extended overhead.
Smoothly reverse the motion, sweeping your arms back down to your sides.
Repeat this continuous, fluid motion for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Curl Narrow Grip
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and grip the barbell with a supinated grip narrower than shoulder-width.
Hold the barbell with arms fully extended in front of your thighs.
Keeping your elbows tucked in, curl the barbell upward toward your chest.
Pause at the top and squeeze your biceps.
Slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Upright Row
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and grip the barbell with an overhand grip slightly narrower than shoulder-width.
Hold the barbell in front of your thighs with arms extended.
Pull the barbell upward toward your chin, leading with your elbows.
Keep the barbell close to your body and raise your elbows above shoulder height.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Biceps Curl
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms extended and palms facing forward.
Keeping your elbows close to your torso, curl both dumbbells upward toward your shoulders.
Pause at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Bicycle Crunches
cues: Lie flat on your back with your hands lightly placed behind your head and knees bent.
Lift your shoulders off the ground and raise your knees to a 90-degree angle.
Extend your right leg while simultaneously rotating your torso to bring your right elbow toward your left knee.
Switch sides, extending the left leg and bringing the left elbow toward the right knee.
Continue alternating in a smooth pedaling motion for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Cable Face Pull
cues: Attach a rope to the high pulley of a cable machine and set the pulley at face height.
Grasp the rope with both hands and step back to create tension in the cable.
Pull the rope toward your face, separating your hands and driving your elbows out to the sides.
Pause at the end of the movement, squeezing your rear delts and upper back.
Slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
cues: Stand next to a low cable pulley and attach a single handle.
Grasp the handle with the hand farthest from the machine and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
With a slight bend in your elbow, raise your arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top, then slowly lower back to the starting position.
Complete the desired repetitions on one side before switching.

name: Cable Pull
cues: Attach a handle to the cable machine and set the pulley at the desired height.
Grasp the handle and position yourself with feet shoulder-width apart and slight knee bend.
Pull the handle toward your torso by driving your elbow back and down.
Pause at the fully contracted position, squeezing your back muscles.
Slowly return to the starting position with a controlled extension.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown (V-Bar Attachment)
cues: Attach a v-bar to the high pulley of a cable machine and stand facing the machine.
Grasp the v-bar with an overhand grip, elbows tucked close to your sides.
With your upper arms stationary, push the bar downward until your arms are fully extended.
Pause at the bottom, squeezing your triceps.
Slowly allow the bar to rise back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Cable Overhead Triceps Extension
cues: Attach a rope to the low pulley of a cable machine and face away from the machine.
Hold the rope overhead with both hands, elbows bent and pointing toward the ceiling.
Extend your arms fully overhead while keeping your elbows stationary.
Pause at the top of the movement, squeezing your triceps.
Slowly lower the rope back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Close Grip Barbell Bench Press
cues: Lie flat on a bench and grip the barbell with hands slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and hold it directly above your chest with arms extended.
Lower the barbell slowly toward your lower chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause briefly at the bottom, then press the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Concentration Curl
cues: Sit on a bench and lean forward slightly, resting your right elbow against the inside of your right thigh.
Hold a dumbbell in your right hand with your arm fully extended.
Curl the dumbbell upward toward your shoulder by flexing your elbow.
Pause at the top and squeeze your bicep fully.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Complete the desired repetitions before switching arms.

name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
cues: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms extended and palms facing your torso.
Curl the right dumbbell diagonally across your body toward your left shoulder.
Pause at the top and squeeze the bicep.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat with the left arm curling toward the right shoulder.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Diamond Push-Up
cues: Start in a push-up position and place your hands together beneath your chest, forming a diamond shape with your thumbs and index fingers.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward your hands by bending your elbows.
Pause just above the floor, then press back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dips
cues: Grip the parallel bars and support your body weight with arms fully extended.
Engage your core and lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows close to your body to focus the movement on the triceps.
Pause at the bottom of the movement.
Press yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
cues: Hold a dumbbell in your right hand and hinge forward at the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Brace your right elbow against your side with the upper arm parallel to the floor.
Extend your forearm back and upward until your arm is fully straight.
Pause at the top, squeezing your tricep.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Complete the desired repetitions before switching sides.

name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl Up
cues: Stand holding dumbbells in both hands with palms facing forward and arms fully extended.
Curl both dumbbells simultaneously upward toward your shoulders.
Keep your elbows stationary and close to your sides throughout the movement.
Pause at the top and squeeze your biceps.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Forearms Curl
cues: Sit on the edge of a bench and rest your forearms on your thighs, palms facing upward.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your wrists just beyond your knees.
Curl the dumbbells upward by flexing your wrists.
Pause at the top of the movement, contracting your forearm muscles.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
cues: Stand holding dumbbells in each hand with palms facing your torso in a neutral grip.
Keeping your elbows stationary and close to your sides, curl the dumbbells upward simultaneously.
Pause at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps and forearms.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
cues: Lie flat on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms extended directly above your chest.
Keeping your upper arms perpendicular to the floor, bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells toward your temples.
Pause just above your head, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Keep your elbows pointed at the ceiling throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Waiter Curl
cues: Stand holding one dumbbell with both hands, cupping the upper weight plate with palms facing upward.
Keep your elbows tucked close to your sides.
Curl the dumbbell upward toward your chin by flexing your elbows.
Pause at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Weighted Arm Circle
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a light dumbbell in each hand, arms extended at your sides.
Raise your arms to shoulder height and make small circular motions forward.
Gradually increase the size of the circles over several repetitions.
Reverse the direction and perform the same number of circles backward.
Lower your arms and rest before repeating.

name: Dynamic Stretch
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Swing both arms forward across your chest, then immediately swing them back out to the sides.
Continue the swinging motion in a controlled, fluid manner.
Gradually increase the range of motion over several repetitions.
Repeat for the desired duration.

name: Ez Bar Biceps Curl
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and grip the ez bar at the inner angled grips with a supinated grip.
Let the bar hang at arm's length in front of your thighs.
Curl the bar upward toward your shoulders, keeping your elbows stationary.
Pause at the top of the movement and squeeze your biceps.
Slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Ez Bar Curl
cues: Stand upright holding an ez bar with a shoulder-width semi-supinated grip.
Allow the bar to hang at arm's length in front of your hips.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders while keeping your elbows close to your torso.
Pause at the top, contracting your biceps.
Slowly lower the bar back to the fully extended position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: High Plank
cues: Start in a push-up position with your hands directly below your shoulders and arms fully extended.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core, glutes, and quads to maintain a rigid position.
Avoid sagging your hips or raising your lower back.
Hold for the desired duration.
Rest and repeat for the desired number of sets.

name: Machine Seated Row
cues: Sit at the seated row machine with your feet on the footpads and knees slightly bent.
Grasp the handles with a neutral or overhand grip and sit upright.
Pull the handles toward your torso, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause at the fully contracted position.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Meadows Row
cues: Position a barbell in a landmine attachment or corner of the room.
Stand perpendicular to the bar and grip the end of the barbell with one hand using an overhand grip.
Hinge at the hips to a roughly 45-degree torso angle with a slight bend in the knees.
Pull the end of the bar upward toward your hip, driving your elbow back.
Pause at the top, squeezing your lat and upper back.
Slowly lower the bar to the starting position and repeat before switching sides.

name: Preacher Curl Machine
cues: Sit at the preacher curl machine and adjust the seat so your upper arms rest flat on the angled pad.
Grasp the handles with a supinated grip and arms fully extended.
Curl the handles upward toward your shoulders by flexing your elbows.
Pause at the top and squeeze your biceps.
Slowly lower the handles back to the fully extended starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Push Up Arm Lift
cues: Start in a standard push-up position with hands below your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Keeping your core engaged and body stable, shift your weight to your left hand.
Lift your right arm off the floor, bending your elbow and pulling your hand back alongside your torso.
Return your right hand to the starting position on the floor.
Shift your weight to your right hand and repeat the movement, lifting your left arm.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Resistance Band Biceps Curl
cues: Stand on the center of a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart, holding one end in each hand.
Start with arms fully extended at your sides and palms facing forward.
Curl both handles upward toward your shoulders by flexing your elbows.
Pause at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Slowly lower your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Resistance Band Overhead Triceps Extension
cues: Assume a half-kneeling position with one knee on the floor, and anchor one end of the resistance band under that kneeling leg.
Grasp the other end of the band with both hands and extend your arms fully overhead.
Keeping your upper arms stationary and close to your head, bend your elbows to slowly lower the hands behind your head.
Pause briefly at the bottom of the movement.
Extend your arms back up to the starting position by straightening your elbows and squeezing your triceps.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Seated Cable Row
cues: Sit on the seated cable row bench with feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grasp the v-bar or cable handles and sit upright with a neutral spine.
Pull the handles toward your lower abdomen, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the fully contracted position.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Seated Lateral Raise
cues: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand resting on your thighs, palms facing inward.
Engage your core and maintain an upright torso.
Raise both arms out to the sides until they are at shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to your thighs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Seated Overhead Dumbbell Extension
cues: Sit on a bench with back support and hold a single dumbbell with both hands overhead.
Grip the dumbbell by cupping the upper weight plate with both palms.
Keeping your upper arms stationary and elbows pointing forward, lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Pause at the bottom of the movement, feeling the stretch in your triceps.
Press the dumbbell back to the overhead starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Seated Shoulder Press Machine
cues: Adjust the seat height on the shoulder press machine so the handles are at shoulder level.
Sit with your back firmly against the pad and grasp the handles with an overhand grip.
Press the handles upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause briefly at the top, then slowly lower the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Seated Triceps Dip Machine
cues: Sit at the triceps dip machine and adjust the seat height so the handles are at chest level.
Grip the handles and position your arms with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
Press the handles downward by extending your elbows until your arms are fully straight.
Pause at the bottom of the movement, squeezing your triceps.
Slowly allow the handles to rise back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Side Plank One Arm Lift
cues: Lie on your side with your legs straight and feet stacked one on top of the other.
Prop yourself up on your forearm, ensuring your elbow is directly beneath your shoulder.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the floor so your body forms a straight line from your head to your heels.
Extend your top arm straight up toward the ceiling.
Hold this static position for the desired amount of time, keeping your hips elevated and core tight.
Lower your hips back to the floor to rest, then switch sides and repeat.

name: Single Arm High Cable Curl
cues: Set a single handle on the high pulley of a cable machine.
Stand facing the machine and grasp the handle with one hand, arm fully extended at shoulder height.
Curl your forearm toward your bicep while keeping your upper arm stationary.
Pause at the fully contracted position, squeezing your bicep.
Slowly extend your arm back to the starting position.
Complete the desired repetitions before switching arms.

name: Standing Barbell Extension
cues: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell at upper chest level with an overhand grip.
Brace your core and press the barbell straight up overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Slowly and with control, lower the barbell back down to the starting position at your upper chest.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Standing Barbell Overhead Extension
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and press a barbell overhead with both hands using a grip slightly narrower than shoulder-width.
Keep your core braced and upper arms perpendicular to the floor.
Slowly bend your elbows to lower the barbell behind your head.
Pause at the bottom, feeling the stretch in your triceps.
Extend your arms back to the overhead starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Standing Cable Concentration Curls
cues: Attach a single handle to the low pulley of a cable machine.
Stand beside the machine and grip the handle with one hand, allowing your arm to fully extend across your body.
Curl the handle upward toward your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Pause at the top and squeeze your bicep.
Slowly lower the handle back to the starting position.
Complete the desired repetitions before switching arms.

name: Standing Single Arm Overhead Extension
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Press the dumbbell overhead, then bend your elbow to lower it behind your head.
Keep your upper arm stationary and close to your head.
Extend your arm back to the starting overhead position.
Pause at the top and squeeze your tricep.
Complete the desired repetitions before switching arms.

name: Standing Supinated Bicep Curl
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with a fully supinated grip, palms facing upward.
Let the barbell hang at arm's length in front of your hips.
Curl the barbell upward toward your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Pause at the top and squeeze your biceps.
Lower the barbell back to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Straight Barbell Curl
cues: Stand holding a straight barbell with an underhand grip at shoulder-width.
Allow the bar to hang at arm's length in front of your thighs.
Curl the bar upward toward your chest, keeping your elbows stationary.
Pause at the top of the movement and squeeze your biceps.
Slowly lower the bar to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Tate Press
cues: Lie flat on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms extended above your chest.
Point your elbows out to the sides and lower the dumbbells toward your chest by bending your elbows.
Lower the dumbbells until they touch your chest with elbows flared wide.
Press the dumbbells back up to the starting position by extending your elbows.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Triceps Cable Pushdown (Rope Attachment)
cues: Attach a rope to the high pulley of a cable machine and stand facing it.
Grasp the rope with both hands and position your elbows at your sides at 90 degrees.
Push the rope downward by extending your elbows, spreading the rope ends apart at the bottom.
Pause with your arms fully extended and triceps contracted.
Slowly return to the starting position allowing your elbows to flex.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Triceps Cable Pushdown (Straight Bar Attachment)
cues: Attach a straight bar to the high pulley of a cable machine.
Stand facing the machine and grip the bar with an overhand grip, elbows tucked to your sides.
Push the bar downward until your arms are fully extended.
Pause at the bottom, squeezing your triceps.
Slowly allow the bar to rise back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Triceps Bench Dip
cues: Sit on the edge of a bench and place your hands beside your hips with fingers pointing forward.
Slide your hips off the bench and extend your legs in front of you.
Lower your body by bending your elbows to roughly 90 degrees.
Pause at the bottom, then press back up by extending your elbows.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Wide Grip Barbell Curl
cues: Stand holding a barbell with a supinated grip wider than shoulder-width.
Let the bar hang at arm's length in front of your thighs.
Curl the bar upward toward your shoulders, keeping your elbows stationary.
Pause at the top and contract your biceps fully.
Slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Wide Grip Seated Cable Row
cues: Attach a straight bar to the low pulley cable and sit with feet on the platform, knees slightly bent.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip wider than shoulder-width.
Sit upright and pull the bar toward your lower chest, driving your elbows wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the contracted position.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Yates Row
