cues: Stand with feet hip-width apart and grip a barbell with an underhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Hinge forward at the hips to approximately a 70-degree upright angle, more upright than a standard bent over row.
Pull the barbell toward your lower abdomen, driving your elbows back.
Pause at the contracted position, squeezing your lats.
Slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Zottman Curl
cues: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells upward toward your shoulders as in a standard curl.
At the top of the movement, rotate your wrists so your palms face downward.
Slowly lower the dumbbells in this pronated position.
At the bottom, rotate your wrists back to the supinated starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: 45-Degree Hyperextension Machine
cues: Position yourself on the hyperextension machine with your hips resting at the top of the pad and feet secured under the footrests.
Cross your arms over your chest or place them behind your head.
Lower your torso downward toward the floor by hinging at the hips.
Pause at the bottom of the movement, feeling the stretch in your lower back.
Raise your torso back to the starting position by contracting your lower back and glutes.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Banded Overhead Press
cues: Stand on the center of a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band at shoulder height with palms facing forward and elbows bent.
Press the band overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower your hands back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Banded Pull-Apart
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a resistance band with both hands at shoulder height, arms extended in front of you.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and pull the band apart by moving your hands outward toward your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the fully extended position.
Slowly return your hands back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Banded Seated Row
cues: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and loop a resistance band around your feet.
Hold the band with both hands, arms extended and back upright.
Pull the band toward your lower abdomen by driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the contracted position.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Bent Over Barbell Row
cues: Stand with feet hip-width apart and grip the barbell with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Hinge forward at the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor, keeping a neutral spine.
Allow the barbell to hang at arm's length below your chest.
Pull the barbell toward your lower ribcage by driving your elbows upward.
Pause at the top, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Slowly lower the bar back to the starting position and repeat.

name: Bent Over Dumbbell Row
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Hinge forward at the hips to bring your torso close to parallel with the floor, maintaining a neutral spine.
Let the dumbbells hang at arm's length below your chest.
Pull both dumbbells toward your hips simultaneously by driving your elbows back.
Pause at the contracted position, squeezing your lats.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position and repeat.

name: Cat Cow Back Stretch
cues: Start on all fours with your wrists directly under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Inhale and drop your belly toward the floor while lifting your chest and tailbone upward (cow position).
Exhale and round your back toward the ceiling, tucking your chin and tailbone (cat position).
Continue alternating between cat and cow positions in a slow, controlled rhythm.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions or duration.

name: Conventional Deadlift
cues: Stand with feet hip-width apart with the barbell over your mid-foot.
Hinge at the hips and grip the bar just outside your legs with an overhand or mixed grip.
Engage your core, brace your back flat, and push the floor away to begin the lift.
Drive your hips forward as the bar passes your knees, finishing in a standing position.
Pause at the top with hips fully extended.
Lower the bar back to the floor under control and repeat.

name: Good Morning
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and position a barbell across your upper back.
Keep your back flat and engage your core.
With a slight bend in your knees, hinge at the hips and lower your torso toward parallel with the floor.
Pause at the bottom, feeling the stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to return to the upright starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Gorilla Row
cues: Place two dumbbells on the floor and hinge forward, gripping both dumbbells while maintaining a flat back.
Row the right dumbbell up toward your hip while using the left dumbbell as a support handle.
Lower the right dumbbell and immediately row the left dumbbell upward.
Continue alternating rows in a rhythmic manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Inverted Row
cues: Set a barbell or rings at waist height and lie underneath it.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip, shoulder-width apart, and hang with arms fully extended.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Pull your chest up to the bar by driving your elbows back.
Pause at the top, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Slowly lower yourself back to the starting position and repeat.

name: Pendlay Row
cues: Stand over a barbell with feet shoulder-width apart and hinge forward until your torso is parallel to the floor.
Grip the barbell with an overhand grip at shoulder-width with arms fully extended.
From a dead stop, explosively row the barbell to your lower chest.
Lower the barbell completely back to the floor between each repetition.
Reset your position, then pull again.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Plank To Downward Dog
cues: Start in a high plank position with hands under your shoulders and body in a straight line.
Push your hips up and back into a downward dog position, forming an inverted V shape.
Press your heels toward the floor and lengthen through your spine.
Pause at the top, feeling the stretch through your back and hamstrings.
Return to the plank position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Prone Back Extension
cues: Lie face down on a mat with your legs extended straight back and arms extended directly in front of you.
Engage your glutes and lower back to lift your chest, arms, and legs slightly off the floor. Keep your neck neutral.
Maintain this elevated body position and slowly sweep your straight arms out to the sides and down toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together as your hands reach your sides.
Slowly reverse the motion, sweeping your arms back forward to the starting position.
Repeat the arm sweep for the desired number of repetitions while keeping your body lifted.

name: Rear Delt Dumbbell Fly
cues: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward at the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Let the dumbbells hang below your chest with palms facing each other.
With a slight bend in your elbows, raise both arms out to the sides until they are at shoulder height.
Pause at the top, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Renegade Row
cues: Start in a high plank position with a dumbbell in each hand, hands under your shoulders.
Keep your feet wider than hip-width for stability and engage your core.
Row the right dumbbell toward your right hip, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Lower the dumbbell and repeat the row on the left side.
Continue alternating rows while maintaining a stable plank position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Resistance Band Deadlift
cues: Stand on the center of a resistance band with feet hip-width apart.
Grip the band at your sides with palms facing inward and hinge forward at the hips.
Keep your back flat and chest tall throughout the movement.
Drive through your heels and extend your hips to stand upright.
Pause at the top with hips fully extended.
Slowly hinge back down to the starting position and repeat.

name: Resistance Band Lat Pulldown
cues: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp a resistance band with both hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and extend your arms straight up overhead.
Keep your core engaged and pull the band apart by driving your elbows down and out to the sides.
Bring the band down behind your neck until it reaches your upper back, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Slowly control the resistance as you raise your arms back to the starting overhead position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Resistance Band W-Raise
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ends of a resistance band with both hands.
Raise your arms in front of you at shoulder height with elbows slightly bent.
Pull the band apart and back, bending your elbows to form a W shape with your arms.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Single Arm Dumbbell Row
cues: Place your right knee and right hand on a bench for support and hold a dumbbell in your left hand.
Let the dumbbell hang directly below your shoulder with arm fully extended.
Row the dumbbell upward toward your left hip by driving your elbow back.
Pause at the top, squeezing your lat.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Complete the desired repetitions before switching sides.

name: Dumbbell Single Leg Deadlift
cues: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in one hand, letting your arm hang straight down.
Shift your weight onto the leg on the same side as the dumbbell (or opposite, depending on your preferred balance), keeping a slight bend in your standing knee.
Hinge forward at your hips, extending your free leg straight out behind you while lowering the dumbbell toward the floor.
Extend your free arm out to the side to help maintain your balance.
Lower your torso until it is nearly parallel to the floor, ensuring your back remains flat.
Drive through the heel of your standing foot and push your hips forward to return to the upright starting position.
Complete the desired number of repetitions, then switch the dumbbell to your other hand and repeat on the opposite leg.

name: Superman Hold
cues: Lie face down on a mat with your arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Simultaneously lift your arms, chest, and legs off the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and lower back at the top of the movement.
Hold the position for 2 to 3 seconds.
Slowly lower back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: T-Bar Row
cues: Position a barbell in a landmine attachment and load weight plates on the free end.
Straddle the bar and grip the handle attachment with both hands.
Hinge forward until your torso is at approximately a 45-degree angle.
Pull the bar toward your chest by driving your elbows back.
Pause at the contracted position, squeezing your back muscles.
Slowly lower the bar back to the starting position and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
cues: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip (palms facing each other).
Hinge forward at your hips while keeping your back straight and a slight bend in your knees.
Let the dumbbells hang straight down toward the floor to begin.
Pull the dumbbells up toward your waist, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the weights back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Wide Grip Pull-Up
cues: Grip a pull-up bar with an overhand grip wider than shoulder-width.
Hang with arms fully extended and engage your core.
Pull your body upward by driving your elbows down toward your hips.
Continue pulling until your chin rises above the bar.
Pause at the top, squeezing your lats.
Slowly lower yourself back to the dead hang position and repeat.

name: Bear Crawl
cues: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and knees hovering an inch above the floor.
Engage your core and keep your back flat.
Move your right hand and left foot forward simultaneously.
Follow with your left hand and right foot, maintaining a low, controlled crawling position.
Continue forward for the desired distance or duration.

name: Box Jump
cues: Stand in front of a sturdy box with feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and swing your arms back to prepare for the jump.
Explosively jump upward and forward onto the box, landing softly with knees bent.
Stand fully upright on the box.
Step down carefully and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Burpee
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor in front of your feet.
Jump or step your feet back into a high plank position.
Perform a push-up, then jump your feet back toward your hands.
Explosively jump upward and raise your arms overhead.
Land softly and immediately repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Butt Kick
cues: Stand with feet hip-width apart and begin jogging in place.
Increase the range of motion by kicking your heels up toward your glutes with each step.
Pump your arms in coordination with your legs.
Maintain an upright posture throughout the movement.
Continue for the desired duration or number of repetitions.

name: High Knee
cues: Stand with feet hip-width apart and begin jogging in place.
Drive your right knee upward toward your chest as high as possible.
Quickly switch legs, driving your left knee upward.
Pump your arms in coordination with each knee drive.
Continue alternating at a brisk pace for the desired duration.

name: Jump Rope
cues: Hold the jump rope handles with one in each hand and position the rope behind your feet.
Begin rotating the rope overhead and jump as it passes beneath your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with a slight bend in your knees.
Maintain a consistent rhythm and keep your wrists doing most of the rotation work.
Continue for the desired duration or number of jumps.

name: Kick Boxing
cues: Stand in a fighting stance with one foot slightly forward and hands raised to guard position.
Throw a series of punches including jabs, crosses, hooks, and uppercuts.
Alternate with front kicks, side kicks, and roundhouse kicks.
Maintain footwork and movement throughout the combination.
Continue for rounds of the desired duration.

name: Lateral Lunge
cues: Stand with feet together and hands on your hips.
Take a wide step out to your right side and bend your right knee as you lower your body.
Keep your left leg straight and your right knee tracking over your right foot.
Lower until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the left side and continue alternating for the desired repetitions.

name: Medicine Ball Slam
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a medicine ball with both hands.
Raise the ball overhead, extending your body fully.
Explosively slam the ball into the floor as hard as possible.
Catch the ball as it rebounds or pick it up from the floor.
Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Place Jog
cues: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Begin jogging in place by alternating lifting each foot off the ground.
Maintain a light, bouncy rhythm on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms naturally to match your leg movement.
Continue for the desired duration.

name: Plank Jack Modification
cues: Start in a high plank position with hands under your shoulders and body in a straight line.
Engage your core and jump both feet out wider than hip-width.
Immediately jump your feet back together.
Continue the in-and-out jumping motion at a controlled pace.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions or duration.

name: Run
cues: Stand upright with a slight forward lean from the ankles.
Begin by pushing off with one foot and landing on the midfoot of the opposite foot.
Drive your arms in coordination with your legs, bending your elbows at 90 degrees.
Maintain a steady breathing rhythm and relaxed shoulders.
Continue at the desired pace for the target distance or duration.

name: Tuck Jump
cues: Stand with feet hip-width apart and bend slightly at the knees.
Explosively jump upward as high as possible.
At the peak of the jump, tuck your knees toward your chest.
Release your knees and land softly with a slight bend in the knees.
Immediately perform the next repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Clap Push-Up
cues: Start in a standard push-up position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower your chest to the floor with a controlled descent.
Explosively push upward with maximum force to lift your hands off the floor.
Clap your hands together quickly before returning your hands to the ground.
Land with soft elbows and immediately lower into the next repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Close Grip (Diamond) Push-Up
cues: Start in a push-up position with your hands placed close together beneath your chest, forming a diamond with your thumbs and index fingers.
Keep your body in a straight line and engage your core.
Lower your chest toward your hands by bending your elbows.
Pause just above the floor.
Press back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Decline Push-Up
cues: Place your feet on an elevated surface such as a bench and position your hands on the floor slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Align your body in a straight line from head to feet.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Pause at the bottom, then press back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Glute Bridge Chest Press
cues: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a dumbbell in each hand at chest height.
Press through your feet to lift your hips into a glute bridge position.
While holding the bridge, press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the dumbbells back to your chest while maintaining the bridge.
Repeat the press for the desired repetitions, then lower your hips.
Rest and repeat for the desired number of sets.

name: Fingers Push-Up
cues: Begin in a standard push-up position but support your weight on your fingertips instead of your palms.
Spread your fingers wide for maximum stability.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Pause at the bottom, then press back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Flat Dumbbell Bench Press
cues: Lie flat on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at chest height with palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended above your chest.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to chest level, elbows flaring slightly outward.
Pause at the bottom, then press back up.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Handstand Push-Up
cues: Kick up into a handstand against a wall with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your body in a straight line.
Slowly lower your head toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Pause when your head lightly touches the floor.
Press back up to the starting handstand position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
cues: Set a bench to a 30 to 45-degree incline and lie back with a barbell racked above.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width and unrack it.
Lower the barbell slowly toward your upper chest.
Pause at the bottom, then press the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
cues: Set a bench to a 30 to 45-degree incline and sit with a dumbbell in each hand.
Lie back and press the dumbbells to chest height with palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to chest level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Incline Push-Up
cues: Place your hands on an elevated surface such as a bench or step, slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Step your feet back so your body forms a straight diagonal line.
Lower your chest toward the surface by bending your elbows.
Pause at the bottom, then press back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Machine Pec Deck Fly
cues: Sit at the pec deck machine and adjust the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
Grasp the handles with elbows slightly bent and upper arms parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your pectorals and bring your arms toward each other in a hugging motion.
Pause at the fully contracted position, holding the contraction briefly.
Slowly allow your arms to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: One Hand Push-Up
cues: Start in a push-up position and widen your feet for extra stability.
Place one hand on the floor beneath your shoulder and place the other hand behind your back.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your working elbow.
Keep your body as square as possible throughout the movement.
Press back up to the starting position.
Complete the desired repetitions before switching arms.

name: Parallettes Push-Up
cues: Set up parallettes on the floor and assume a push-up position gripping the handles.
Keep your body in a straight line and engage your core.
Lower your chest below the level of the handles by bending your elbows.
Pause at the bottom with a deep range of motion.
Press back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Resistance Band Chest Press
cues: Anchor a resistance band behind you at chest height and hold one end in each hand.
Step forward to create tension and stand in a staggered stance.
Press both hands forward until your arms are fully extended in front of your chest.
Pause at the extended position, squeezing your pectorals.
Slowly bring your hands back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Resistance Band Push-Up
cues: Loop a resistance band across your upper back and hold one end under each hand.
Assume a standard push-up position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Press back up against the added resistance of the band.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Seated Machine Chest Press
cues: Adjust the seat of the chest press machine so the handles are at chest level.
Sit with your back flat against the pad and grip the handles with an overhand grip.
Press the handles forward until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly, then slowly bring the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Standard Push-Up
cues: Place your hands on the floor slightly wider than shoulder-width and extend your legs behind you.
Align your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest to the floor by bending your elbows at a 45-degree angle.
Pause just above the floor.
Press back up to the starting position by fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Wide Grip Push-Up
cues: Place your hands on the floor significantly wider than shoulder-width.
Extend your legs behind you and align your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows outward.
Pause at the bottom, then press back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Air Squat
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes pointed slightly outward.
Engage your core and push your hips back as you bend your knees.
Lower your body until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Keep your chest tall and your knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to return to the standing position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Band Squat
cues: Place a resistance band just above your knees and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your knees outward against the band to activate your glutes.
Lower into a squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking outward against the band resistance.
Press through your heels to return to standing.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Banded Seated Abduction
cues: Sit on the edge of a bench or chair and place a resistance band around both thighs just above the knees.
Sit with feet flat on the floor and knees at 90 degrees.
Push both knees outward against the resistance of the band.
Pause at the widest position, contracting your outer glutes.
Slowly bring your knees back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Back Squat
cues: Position a barbell across your upper back and step away from the rack with feet shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and push your hips back to begin the squat.
Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the floor or deeper.
Keep your chest tall, knees out, and back neutral throughout.
Drive through your heels to return to the standing position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Front Squat
cues: Position a barbell on your front deltoids and collarbone, holding it with a clean grip or crossed-arm grip.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and elbows raised high.
Descend into a squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Keep an upright torso and elbows elevated throughout.
Drive through your heels to return to standing.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
cues: Sit with your upper back against a bench and place a barbell across your hips.
Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the floor hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes to thrust your hips upward.
Raise until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Pause at the top, holding the glute contraction.
Lower your hips back to the starting position and repeat.

name: Barbell March Standing
cues: Stand with a barbell positioned across your upper back as in a back squat.
Engage your core and stand tall.
Lift your right knee upward toward your chest in a marching motion.
Lower your right foot and immediately lift your left knee.
Continue alternating in a controlled marching cadence.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
cues: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
Push your hips back and hinge forward while keeping your back flat and bar close to your legs.
Lower the bar until you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings.
Pause at the bottom, then drive your hips forward to return to standing.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Standing Calf Raise
cues: Place a barbell across your upper back and stand with the balls of your feet on a raised surface.
Let your heels drop below the platform to get a full calf stretch.
Press through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as possible.
Pause at the top, squeezing your calf muscles.
Slowly lower your heels back below the platform.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Sumo Deadlift
cues: Stand with feet significantly wider than shoulder-width and toes pointed outward.
Grip the barbell with hands inside your legs using an overhand or mixed grip.
Engage your core, brace your back flat, and push the floor outward to begin the lift.
Drive your hips forward as the bar rises, finishing in a standing position with hips fully extended.
Slowly lower the bar back to the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
cues: Stand a few feet in front of a bench and place the top of your right foot on it.
Lower your body by bending your left knee until your left thigh is parallel to the floor.
Keep your front knee tracking over your toes and your torso upright.
Press through your left heel to return to the starting position.
Complete the desired repetitions before switching legs.

name: Cable Hip Abduction
cues: Attach an ankle cuff to the low pulley of a cable machine and fasten it to your right ankle.
Stand sideways with your left side closest to the machine and hold the machine for balance.
Keeping your leg straight, raise your right leg out to the side against the cable resistance.
Pause at the top, squeezing your outer glute.
Slowly lower your leg back to the starting position.
Complete the desired repetitions before switching legs.

name: Curtsy Lunge
cues: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips.
Step your right foot diagonally behind and to the left of your left foot.
Bend both knees and lower your right knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee tracking over your front foot.
Press through your left heel to return to standing.
Repeat on the opposite side and continue alternating for the desired repetitions.

name: Donkey Single Leg Kick
cues: Start on all fours with hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Keep your right knee bent at 90 degrees and flex your right foot.
Push your right heel upward toward the ceiling while squeezing your glute.
Pause at the top of the movement, fully contracting your glute.
Lower your knee back toward the floor without touching it.
Repeat for the desired repetitions before switching legs.

name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
cues: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Position the balls of your feet on the edge of a raised surface if available.
Press through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as possible.
Pause at the top, squeezing your calf muscles.
Slowly lower your heels back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell March
cues: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Engage your core and maintain an upright posture.
Lift your right knee upward toward your hip level.
Lower it and immediately lift your left knee.
Continue alternating in a controlled marching cadence.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
cues: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back and hinge forward, lowering the dumbbells along your legs.
Keep your back flat and lower the dumbbells until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to return to the standing position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cues: Sit or stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with palms facing forward.
Engage your core and press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Avoid locking out your elbows at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Deadlift
cues: Stand with feet wide apart and toes pointed outward, holding a single dumbbell with both hands between your legs.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to lower the dumbbell toward the floor.
Keep your back flat and chest tall throughout the movement.
Press through your heels and inner feet to return to the standing position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
cues: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Perform a full squat, lowering until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
As you drive upward from the squat, press the dumbbells overhead.
Fully extend your legs and arms at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height as you descend into the next squat.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Fire Hydrant
cues: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Keep your right knee bent at 90 degrees and lift it out to the side.
Raise your knee as high as your hip level while keeping your back flat.
Pause at the top, squeezing your outer glute.
Slowly lower your knee back to the starting position.
Complete the desired repetitions before switching sides.

name: Goblet Squat
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell vertically at chest height with both hands.
Push your hips back and lower into a squat until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Keep your chest tall, elbows inside your knees, and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to return to the standing position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Hammer Raise Front
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip, palms facing each other.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and raise both dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Hamstring Stretch
cues: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp a resistance band with both hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and extend your arms straight up overhead.
Keep your core engaged and pull the band apart by driving your elbows down and out to the sides.
Bring the band down behind your neck until it reaches your upper back, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Slowly control the resistance as you raise your arms back to the starting overhead position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Jefferson Squat
cues: Straddle a loaded barbell with one foot in front and one behind, perpendicular to the bar.
Grip the bar with one hand in front and one hand behind your body.
Lower your body by bending both knees until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your torso upright and drive through both feet to stand.
Pause at the top, then lower for the next repetition.
Alternate your lead foot between sets.

name: Jump Squat
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Perform a squat by lowering your hips until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Explosively jump upward from the bottom of the squat.
Extend your arms overhead or keep them at your sides.
Land softly with knees slightly bent and immediately lower into the next squat.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Jumping Jack With Resistance Band
cues: Place a resistance band around your ankles and stand with feet together.
Jump and spread your feet wide against the resistance of the band while raising your arms overhead.
Jump your feet back together.
Continue at a steady, controlled rhythm.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Kettlebell Dumbbell Swing
cues: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width holding a kettlebell or dumbbell with both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the weight back between your legs.
Explosively drive your hips forward to propel the weight up to shoulder height.
Let the weight swing back down and immediately hinge into the next repetition.
Maintain a flat back and engaged core throughout.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Kettlebell Swing
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a kettlebell on the floor between your feet.
Hinge at the hips to grip the kettlebell with both hands.
Swing it back between your legs to create momentum.
Drive your hips explosively forward, propelling the kettlebell up to shoulder height.
Allow gravity to bring it back down and immediately hinge for the next rep.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Leg Extension Machine
cues: Sit on the leg extension machine and adjust the pad so it rests on the top of your shins.
Grip the handles on the sides of the seat for support.
Extend your legs upward until they are fully straight.
Pause at the top, squeezing your quads.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Leg Press Machine
cues: Sit in the leg press machine and place your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Release the safety handles and lower the platform toward your chest by bending your knees.
Pause at the bottom when your thighs are just above parallel to the platform.
Press the platform away by extending your knees.
Re-engage the safety when complete.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Lying Leg Curl Machine
cues: Lie face down on the leg curl machine and position the pad just above your heels.
Grip the handles for stability and engage your core.
Curl your legs upward by bending your knees, bringing your heels toward your glutes.
Pause at the top, squeezing your hamstrings.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Lying Leg Lift Up
cues: Lie flat on your back with legs extended and hands beneath your lower back or flat on the floor.
Keep your legs together and raise them upward until they are perpendicular to the floor.
Pause at the top, contracting your abs.
Slowly lower your legs back toward the floor without fully touching it.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Lying Leg Raise
cues: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and hands placed beneath your lower back.
Raise both legs off the ground until they are perpendicular to the floor.
Slowly lower your legs toward the floor, stopping a few inches above it.
Pause, then raise your legs again for the next repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Resistance Band Good Morning
cues: Stand on the center of a resistance band and place the looped ends over your shoulders.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and a slight bend in your knees.
Hinge at your hips and lower your torso toward parallel while keeping your back flat.
Pause at the bottom, feeling the stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to return to the upright position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Resistance Band Monster Walk
cues: Place a resistance band around your ankles and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Slightly bend your knees and get into an athletic quarter-squat position.
Take a large step forward and to the right, maintaining tension in the band.
Follow with your left foot, keeping feet apart against the band resistance.
Continue walking forward for the desired distance, then reverse direction.
Repeat for the desired number of steps or duration.

name: Resistance Band Squat With Lateral Raise
cues: Stand on the center of a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the ends in each hand.
Lower into a squat as you hold the band handles at your sides.
As you press back up to standing, raise both arms out to the sides to shoulder height against the band.
Lower your arms as you descend into the next squat.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Resistance Band Squat
cues: Stand on the center of a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band handles at shoulder height with palms facing forward.
Lower into a squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to return to standing.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Skater Hops
cues: Stand on your right leg with a slight knee bend.
Push off your right foot and hop laterally to land on your left foot.
Land softly on your left foot with a bent knee to absorb the impact.
Immediately push off to the right and land on your right foot.
Continue hopping side to side in a skating motion.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions or duration.

name: Smith Machine Squat
cues: Set the bar height on the smith machine to shoulder level and step under the bar.
Position the bar across your upper back and release the safety latches.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes pointed slightly outward.
Lower into a squat until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Press through your heels to return to standing.
Re-engage the safety when complete.

name: Squat Machine
cues: Adjust the squat machine pads to fit your shoulder width and step into the machine.
Position the shoulder pads on your shoulders and release the safety.
Lower into a squat by bending your knees until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Press through your feet to return to the starting position.
Re-engage the safety and step out when finished.

name: Standing Calf Raise
cues: Stand with feet hip-width apart on a flat surface or with the balls of your feet on a raised edge.
Press through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as possible.
Pause at the top, squeezing your calves.
Slowly lower your heels back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Sumo Squat
cues: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width apart and toes pointed significantly outward.
Place your hands on your hips or clasp them in front of your chest.
Lower into a squat by bending both knees, keeping them tracking over your toes.
Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Press through your heels to return to standing.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Walking Lunge
cues: Stand upright with feet together and hands on your hips or at your sides.
Step your right foot forward and lower your body by bending both knees.
Lower your back knee toward the floor without touching it.
Push through your right foot and bring your left foot forward to step into the next lunge.
Continue walking forward for the desired number of steps or distance.

name: Weighted Step-Up
cues: Stand in front of a sturdy box or bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Step your right foot onto the surface and press through your right heel to lift your body up.
Bring your left foot up to stand fully on the box.
Step your right foot back down, followed by your left.
Continue leading with the same leg or alternate sides for the desired repetitions.

name: Banded Lateral Raise
cues: Stand on the center of a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold one end of the band in each hand with arms at your sides.
With a slight bend in your elbows, raise both arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Banded Pull-Apart (Rear Delt Focus)
cues: Hold a resistance band with both hands at shoulder height, arms extended in front of you.
Maintain a shoulder-width grip and slight elbow bend.
Pull the band apart horizontally by moving both hands outward toward your sides.
Focus on squeezing your rear deltoids and shoulder blades at the end of the pull.
Slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Cable Upright Row
cues: Attach a straight bar or rope to the low pulley of a cable machine.
Stand facing the machine and grip the attachment with an overhand grip slightly narrower than shoulder-width.
Pull the attachment straight up toward your chin, leading with your elbows.
Keep the bar close to your body and raise your elbows above shoulder height.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower the attachment back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumb Waiter Dumbbell
cues: Stand with elbows bent at 90 degrees and tucked close to your sides, forearms parallel to the floor.
Hold a light dumbbell in each hand with palms facing upward.
Keeping your elbows at your sides, externally rotate your shoulders to open your forearms outward.
Pause at the widest point, feeling the contraction in your rear delts.
Slowly rotate back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
cues: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with arms fully extended.
Keep your arms straight and shrug your shoulders upward toward your ears as high as possible.
Pause at the top, squeezing your traps.
Slowly lower your shoulders back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Y-Raise
cues: Lie prone on an incline bench set to approximately 45 degrees, holding light dumbbells in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down toward the floor.
Raise both arms upward and outward at a diagonal, forming a Y shape with your body.
Pause at the top, squeezing your upper back and rear delts.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Elevated Pike Push-Up
cues: Place your feet on a bench and walk your hands toward the bench so your hips are elevated and your body forms an inverted V.
Position your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower the top of your head toward the floor by bending your elbows outward.
Pause when your head is near the floor.
Press back up to the inverted V starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Incline Bench Rear Delt Fly
cues: Lie prone on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand hanging toward the floor.
With a slight bend in your elbows, raise both arms out to the sides until they are at shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades and rear deltoids at the top.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the hanging starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Rear Delt Fly Machine
cues: Sit at the rear delt fly machine facing the pad with arms extended and hands gripping the handles.
Set the handles at shoulder height.
Pull the handles outward and backward in a wide arc, squeezing your rear delts.
Pause at the end of the range of motion.
Slowly return the handles to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Resistance Band High Side Pull
cues: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp a resistance band with both hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and extend your arms straight up overhead.
Keep your core engaged and pull the band apart by driving your elbows down and out to the sides.
Bring the band down behind your neck until it reaches your upper back, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Slowly control the resistance as you raise your arms back to the starting overhead position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Resistance Band Shoulder Roll
cues: Hold a resistance band with both hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, arms at your sides.
Roll your shoulders forward in a circular motion while maintaining gentle tension on the band.
Complete several forward circles, then reverse the direction.
Keep the movements slow and controlled.
Repeat for the desired duration or repetitions.

name: Reverse Grip Barbell Upright Row
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and grip the barbell with an underhand grip slightly narrower than shoulder-width.
Hold the barbell in front of your thighs with arms extended.
Pull the barbell upward toward your chin by leading with your elbows.
Keep the bar close to your body throughout the movement.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Seated Behind-The-Neck Press
cues: Sit on a bench with back support and position a barbell across your upper traps behind your neck.
Grip the bar wider than shoulder-width with an overhand grip.
Press the bar upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Slowly lower the bar back behind your neck to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Shoulder Landmine Press
cues: Position a barbell in a landmine attachment and load the free end.
Stand perpendicular to the bar and hold the end of the barbell at shoulder height with one hand.
Press the bar upward and forward in an arc until your arm is fully extended.
Pause at the top, then lower the bar back to shoulder height.
Complete the desired repetitions before switching arms.

name: Standing Arnold Press
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your shoulders with palms facing you.
As you press the dumbbells overhead, rotate your palms to face forward.
Extend your arms fully overhead.
Reverse the rotation as you lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with palms facing you.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Standing Overhead Military Press
cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and grip the barbell with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Hold the barbell at shoulder height with elbows just in front of the bar.
Engage your core and press the bar straight overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower the bar back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Ab Wheel Workout
cues: Kneel on the floor and grip the ab wheel handles with both hands, positioning it directly beneath your shoulders.
Engage your core and slowly roll the wheel forward, extending your body towards the ground.
Continue rolling out as far as you can while keeping your back flat and hips from sagging.
Pause briefly at full extension, then use your core to pull the wheel back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Ardha Matsyendrasana (Seated Spinal Twist)
cues: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you.
Bend your right knee and place your right foot flat on the floor outside your left thigh.
Place your right hand behind you on the floor for support and wrap your left arm around your right knee.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, then exhale and twist your torso to the right as far as comfortably possible.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then return to center and repeat on the opposite side.

name: Arm Stretch
cues: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and your back straight.
Slowly raise both arms out to your sides simultaneously.
Continue lifting until your arms are fully extended and parallel to the floor.
Reach outward through your fingertips, feeling a stretch across your chest and shoulders.
Hold this extended position for 20-30 seconds.
Slowly lower your arms back to your sides.

name: Bird Dog Advanced (Both Hands Raise)
cues: Begin on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Engage your core to stabilize your spine and keep your back flat.
Simultaneously raise both arms straight forward while extending both legs behind you, balancing on your torso.
Hold the position for 2-3 seconds, maintaining a neutral spine and avoiding rotation.
Lower back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Bird Dog
cues: Begin on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Engage your core and keep your back flat throughout the movement.
Simultaneously extend your right arm forward and your left leg back, keeping both parallel to the floor.
Hold for 2-3 seconds, then return to the starting position.
Repeat on the opposite side, extending your left arm and right leg, and continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Bridge Pose - Wheel Prep Bridge
cues: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Place your arms alongside your body with palms facing down.
Press through your feet and engage your glutes to lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Hold at the top for 2-3 seconds, squeezing your glutes and keeping your core engaged.
Slowly lower your hips back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
cues: Stand about two feet in front of a bench or elevated surface and place the top of one foot on the bench behind you.
Ensure your front foot is far enough forward that your knee does not travel past your toes during the descent.
Engage your core and lower your back knee towards the ground by bending your front leg.
Descend until your front thigh is approximately parallel to the floor.
Drive through your front heel to return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.

name: Burpee
cues: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms by your sides.
Bend your knees and place your hands on the floor, then jump or step your feet back into a push-up position.
Perform one push-up, keeping your body in a straight line.
Jump or step your feet back towards your hands, then explosively jump upward with your arms overhead.
Land softly with slightly bent knees and immediately begin the next repetition.

name: Butt Kick Jog Cardio
cues: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your arms bent at 90 degrees at your sides.
Begin jogging in place at a moderate pace.
With each stride, kick your heel up towards your glutes as high as comfortably possible.
Alternate legs in a continuous jogging rhythm, keeping your core engaged and your torso upright.
Continue for the desired duration or number of repetitions.

name: Cat Pose Stretching
cues: Begin on all fours with your wrists directly under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Inhale to prepare, then exhale and round your spine upward toward the ceiling, tucking your chin to your chest and your tailbone under.
Hold the rounded position for 2-3 seconds, feeling the stretch through your back.
Slowly return your spine to a neutral position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, coordinating the movement with your breath.

name: Chaturanga To Upward Dog
cues: Begin in a high plank position with your hands placed slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body slowly by bending your elbows close to your sides until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Hold the chaturanga position briefly, then press through your hands and extend your arms while lifting your chest and rolling over your toes into upward-facing dog.
In upward dog, ensure your thighs and shins are off the floor, your shoulders are away from your ears, and your chest is open.
Hold for a breath, then transition back to downward dog or repeat the sequence for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Child Pose
cues: Kneel on the floor with your big toes together and knees hip-width apart.
Sit back onto your heels, then fold your torso forward and extend your arms straight out in front of you on the floor.
Rest your forehead gently on the ground and relax your shoulders toward the floor.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply and allowing your back to lengthen.
Slowly walk your hands back in and rise to the starting position.

name: Clap Push Up
cues: Begin in a standard push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lower your chest toward the floor in a controlled manner, keeping your body in a straight line.
Explosively push up with maximum force so your hands leave the ground.
While airborne, quickly clap your hands together, then return your hands to the floor to catch yourself.
Absorb the landing with slightly bent elbows and immediately begin the next repetition.

name: Close Grip Push Ups
cues: Begin in a plank position with your hands placed directly under your chest, closer than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your sides throughout the movement.
Lower your chest toward the floor in a controlled manner, keeping your core engaged and your body in a straight line.
Pause briefly at the bottom, then press through your palms to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Resistance Band Supine Hamstring Stretch
cues: Lie flat on your back on the floor.
Loop a resistance band or long strap around the arch of one foot, holding the ends of the band with your hands.
Keep your opposite leg resting flat on the floor.
Keeping the banded leg straight, use the band to help pull your leg upward toward the ceiling.
Raise the leg until you feel a stretch in your hamstring and hold briefly.
Slowly lower the leg back to the floor with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.

name: Controlled Kick Forearm Stand Flow
cues: Begin in a forearm plank position with your elbows directly under your shoulders and forearms flat on the floor.
Walk your feet in toward your elbows, lifting your hips high to create an inverted V shape.
Engage your core and kick one leg upward while pressing firmly into your forearms.
Control the kick and hold the forearm stand position for 2-3 seconds, stacking your hips over your shoulders.
Slowly lower the leg back down and repeat on the other side for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Cow Pose Stretch
cues: Begin on all fours with your wrists directly under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Inhale and slowly let your belly drop toward the floor, lifting your head and tailbone upward.
Hold the arched position for 2-3 seconds, feeling the stretch through your chest and lower back.
Exhale and return your spine to a neutral position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, coordinating the movement with your breath.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
cues: Stand or sit upright with your back straight and core engaged.
Extend one arm straight across your body at chest height.
Use your opposite forearm or hand to press the arm gently toward your chest.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, feeling tension in the back of your shoulder.
Release and repeat on the other side.

name: Crow Pose
cues: Squat down and place your hands flat on the floor, shoulder-width apart, with fingers spread wide.
Bend your elbows slightly and place your knees on the backs of your upper arms, as high up as possible.
Lean your weight forward into your hands and slowly lift one foot off the floor, then the other.
Balance on your hands with your core engaged and your gaze slightly forward.
Hold the position for as long as possible, then slowly lower your feet back to the floor.

name: Decline Push Ups
cues: Place your feet on an elevated surface such as a bench or step and position your hands on the floor, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Ensure your body forms a straight line from head to heels with your core engaged.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows, keeping them at roughly a 45-degree angle to your body.
Pause briefly at the bottom when your chest is just above the floor.
Press back up to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Depth Jump
cues: Stand on top of a sturdy box or elevated platform with your feet hip-width apart.
Step off the box and land with both feet simultaneously on the floor below.
Upon landing, immediately and explosively jump upward as high as possible with your arms swinging overhead.
Land softly with slightly bent knees to absorb the impact.
Reset and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Diamond Push Up
cues: Begin in a plank position and bring your hands together beneath your sternum, touching your thumbs and index fingers to form a diamond shape.
Keep your elbows close to your body throughout the movement and engage your core.
Lower your chest toward your hands in a controlled manner until it nearly touches the floor.
Pause briefly at the bottom, then press back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dolphin Plank Hold
cues: Begin in a forearm plank position with your elbows directly beneath your shoulders and forearms flat on the floor.
Engage your core, glutes, and legs to maintain a straight line from head to heels.
Press your forearms firmly into the floor and keep your hips level, avoiding any sagging or piking.
Hold the position for the desired duration while breathing steadily.
Release by lowering your knees to the floor.

name: Downward Dog Hold
cues: Begin in a plank position with your hands shoulder-width apart and fingers spread wide.
Press through your palms and lift your hips toward the ceiling, straightening your legs and lowering your heels toward the floor.
Your body should form an inverted V-shape with your head positioned between your arms.
Engage your core and press your chest gently toward your thighs to deepen the shoulder stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then return to the starting position.

name: Dragon Flags - Core Mastery
cues: Lie flat on your back on the floor and reach behind your head to firmly grip a sturdy vertical pole with both hands.
Brace your core and lift your legs, hips, and lower back off the floor, keeping your body in a rigid, straight line.
Raise your body upward until your weight is supported entirely by your upper back and shoulders.
Slowly lower your body back toward the floor in a controlled manner, maintaining the stiff, straight-line position.
Stop just before your body touches the floor, then repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dynamic Arms Stretch
cues: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms resting by your sides.
Engage your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly raise both arms out to your sides simultaneously.
Continue lifting until your arms are fully extended and parallel to the floor, keeping your palms facing down.
Pause and hold this extended position briefly.
Slowly lower your arms back to your sides and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dynamic Upper Body Stretch
cues: Stand upright with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart.
Raise both arms overhead, keeping your elbows slightly bent so your hands frame your head.
Engage your core and slowly bend your torso to one side, keeping your chest facing forward.
Pause briefly when you feel a stretch along the side of your body.
Slowly return to the upright center position.
Bend to the opposite side and continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Fast Feet Sprint (Low Stance)
cues: Stand in a low athletic stance with your knees slightly bent, feet hip-width apart, and your weight on the balls of your feet.
Lower your hips slightly as if in a quarter squat, keeping your chest up and back straight.
Begin rapidly alternating your feet in short, quick steps while maintaining the low stance.
Pump your arms quickly to drive the pace of your feet.
Continue for the desired duration, keeping the tempo as fast as possible throughout.

name: Fold With Hinge
cues: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and a slight bend in your knees.
Hinge forward at the hips, pushing your hips backward while keeping your back flat and chest lifted.
Lower your torso until you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings, then allow your torso to round gently into a full forward fold.
Hold the folded position for 2-3 seconds, then re-engage your core and hinge back up to standing.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Forward Lunges
cues: Stand tall with your feet together and your hands on your hips or hanging by your sides.
Step one foot forward into a wide stance and lower your back knee toward the floor by bending both legs.
Descend until your front thigh is approximately parallel to the floor and your back knee hovers just above the ground.
Drive through your front heel to push back to the starting position.
Alternate legs and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Full Wheel Entry - Wheel Prep Bridge
cues: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor near your glutes.
Place your hands beside your ears on the floor with your fingers pointing toward your shoulders.
Press into your hands and feet simultaneously to lift your hips, then your torso, off the floor.
Extend your arms and legs as fully as possible, lifting the crown of your head off the floor and opening your chest.
Hold for the desired duration, then tuck your chin and slowly lower back down to the floor with control.

name: Gentle Fold Seated Forward Fold
cues: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you and your feet flexed.
Sit up tall with your spine lengthened and your hands resting beside your thighs.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, then exhale and gently hinge forward from your hips, reaching your hands toward your feet.
Go only as far as comfortable without rounding your lower back excessively.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply, then slowly sit back up.

name: Glute Bridge
cues: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Place your arms alongside your body with palms facing down.
Engage your glutes and core, then press through your feet to lift your hips off the floor.
Rise until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Slowly lower your hips back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Goblet Squat Entry
cues: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and toes turned out slightly.
Clasp your hands together at chest height or hold them as if gripping an imaginary weight at your sternum.
Engage your core and push your hips back and down as you lower into a squat.
Descend until your thighs are at or below parallel to the floor, keeping your chest upright and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Half Lift Transition Yoga
cues: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hinge forward from your hips into a forward fold.
Place your hands on your shins or thighs for support.
Inhale and lift your torso halfway up until your back is flat and parallel to the floor.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears and lengthen your neck to extend your spine.
Hold for a breath, then exhale and fold back down or continue into the next yoga pose.

name: Hanging Leg Raises
cues: Hang from a pull-up bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip and your arms fully extended.
Engage your core and keep your legs straight as you raise them upward in front of you.
Continue lifting until your legs are parallel to the floor or as high as your flexibility allows.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions without swinging your body.

name: High Knee Butt Kick
cues: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and begin jogging in place.
Alternate between driving your knees up toward your chest and kicking your heels up toward your glutes with each stride.
Pump your arms in coordination with your legs to maintain an athletic rhythm.
Keep your core engaged and your posture upright throughout the movement.
Continue alternating for the desired duration or number of repetitions.

name: High Knee Cardio
cues: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms bent at your sides.
Begin running in place, driving your knees up toward your chest with each stride.
Aim to bring each knee to at least hip height with every step.
Pump your arms opposite to your legs to maintain balance and rhythm.
Continue at a fast pace for the desired duration.

name: Hip Circle Version 2
cues: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and place your hands on your hips.
Shift your weight to one leg and lift the opposite leg in front of you.
Sweep the lifted leg out to the side in a wide, controlled circular motion to open your hip.
Bring the leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat the same motion with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions, keeping your torso still.

name: Hip Flexor Stretch (Kneeling)
cues: Kneel on one knee with your other foot planted flat on the floor in front of you, creating a 90-degree angle at both knees.
Keep your torso upright and engage your core.
Gently shift your weight forward, pushing your front hip toward the floor until you feel a stretch in the front of your rear hip.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply.
Release and repeat on the other side.

name: Hip Stretch
cues: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and place both hands on your hips.
Keeping your legs straight and feet flat on the floor, slowly push your hips out to one side.
Keep your upper body still and upright as you feel a gentle stretch along your outer hip.
Pause briefly, then bring your hips back to the centered starting position.
Push your hips to the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Hips Flexor Lunges
cues: Stand with your feet together and your hands on your hips.
Step one foot forward and lower into a lunge until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
At the bottom of the lunge, tilt your pelvis slightly posteriorly to feel an increased stretch in the front of your rear hip.
Hold for 2-3 seconds at the bottom, then drive through your front heel to return to standing.
Alternate legs and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Hollow Hold
cues: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended overhead and your legs straight.
Press your lower back firmly into the floor and engage your abs.
Simultaneously lift your arms, head, shoulders, and legs off the floor, keeping your legs straight and together.
Your body should form a slightly curved dish or hollow shape.
Hold the position for the desired duration while breathing steadily.

name: Inchworm Walkout
cues: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward at the hips and place your hands on the floor in front of your feet.
Walk your hands forward one at a time until you reach a full plank position.
Hold the plank briefly, then walk your hands back toward your feet.
Stand back up and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Incline Push Ups
cues: Place your hands on an elevated surface such as a bench, step, or wall, with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step your feet back so your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the elevated surface by bending your elbows.
Pause briefly at the bottom, then press back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Jump Box
cues: Stand in front of a sturdy box or platform with your feet hip-width apart.
Bend your knees and swing your arms back to prepare for the jump.
Explosively jump upward and forward, driving your arms overhead and landing softly on top of the box with both feet.
Stand fully upright on the box, then step or jump back down to the starting position.
Reset and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Jump Squats
cues: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly pointed outward.
Lower into a squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping your chest upright.
Explosively drive through your heels and jump as high as possible off the ground, extending your arms overhead.
Land softly with slightly bent knees to absorb the impact.
Immediately lower back into the next squat and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Jumping Jack With High Knee
cues: Stand with your feet together and your arms by your sides.
Jump your feet outward while raising your arms overhead as in a standard jumping jack.
Jump your feet back together, then immediately drive one knee up toward your chest.
Lower that foot and perform another jumping jack, then drive the opposite knee up on the return.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Jumping Jack
cues: Stand with your feet together and your arms by your sides.
Jump your feet outward to slightly wider than shoulder-width apart while simultaneously raising your arms out to the sides and overhead.
Pause briefly at the top, then jump your feet back together while lowering your arms to your sides.
Maintain a rhythmic, continuous pace throughout the exercise.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Kapalabhati Pulses Pranayama Ladder
cues: Sit comfortably in a cross-legged position with your spine tall and shoulders relaxed.
Take a deep inhale to begin, then perform rapid, forceful exhales through the nose by sharply contracting your lower abdomen.
Allow the inhale to occur passively between each forced exhale, without conscious effort.
Start with a slow pace, then progressively increase the speed of the exhales in rounds or a ladder pattern.
Complete the desired number of rounds, then rest with natural breathing.

name: Knuckle Push Ups
cues: Begin in a push-up position but make fists with both hands and place your knuckles on the floor, aligned under your shoulders.
Keep your wrists neutral and straight throughout the movement.
Lower your chest toward the floor in a controlled manner, keeping your elbows at roughly a 45-degree angle to your body.
Pause briefly at the bottom, then press back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: L-Sit Hold
cues: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you.
Place your hands flat on the floor beside your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Press through your palms to lift your entire body off the floor, keeping your legs straight and parallel to the ground.
Hold the L-shape position for as long as possible, engaging your abs and keeping your back straight.
Slowly lower back down to the floor and rest before repeating.

name: Lateral Sprint Shuffles
cues: Stand in a low athletic stance with your knees slightly bent and your weight on the balls of your feet.
Push off your inside foot and shuffle laterally in one direction by stepping and bringing your feet together repeatedly.
Keep your hips low and your chest up throughout the movement.
After the desired distance, plant your outside foot and shuffle back in the opposite direction.
Continue shuffling back and forth for the desired duration.

name: Leg Lift Progression - Headstand Preparation
cues: Set up in a bound headstand position on the floor, positioned in front of a sturdy chair.
Lift your hips and place one foot onto the seat of the chair for support, extending your other leg straight up.
Engage your core and slowly lift the foot off the chair, bringing it up to meet your extended leg in a full headstand.
Pause briefly at the top, maintaining balance and a tight core.
Slowly lower one leg back down to rest on the chair with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Leg Stretch Hand On Hips
cues: Stand upright with your feet close together and place your hands on your hips.
Shift your weight slightly onto one leg to balance.
Keeping your opposite leg straight, lift it slightly forward off the floor.
Point your toes downward toward the floor as you lift.
Lower your foot back to the starting position.
Alternate legs and continue the movement for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Leg Swing Front To Back
cues: Stand on one leg with your hand on a wall or support for balance.
Engage your core and swing the free leg forward to hip height, then smoothly swing it behind you as far as comfortably possible.
Keep the movement controlled and use momentum to gradually increase your range of motion.
Complete the desired number of swings, then switch legs and repeat.

name: Leg Swing In Circle
cues: Stand on one leg and hold a wall or support for balance.
Lift the opposite leg slightly off the floor and begin tracing large, controlled circles with that leg.
Move the leg forward, out to the side, behind you, and back to the start in a full circular motion.
Complete the desired number of circles in one direction, then reverse.
Switch legs and repeat on the other side.

name: Leg Swing Side To Side
cues: Stand sideways next to a wall or support and place one hand on it for balance.
Engage your core and swing the free leg across your body to the opposite side, then swing it outward as far as comfortably possible.
Keep the swinging motion controlled and allow momentum to gradually open the range of motion.
Complete the desired number of swings, then turn around and repeat on the other leg.

name: Leg Swing
cues: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and place your hands on your hips.
Shift your weight onto one leg, keeping a slight bend in the knee for stability.
Lift your opposite foot slightly and swing it horizontally across the front of your standing leg.
Swing the same leg back in the opposite direction, bringing it out wide to the side.
Continue swinging the leg side to side in a controlled pendulum motion.
Complete the desired number of swings, then switch legs and repeat.

name: Mountain Climber
cues: Begin in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Engage your core and drive your right knee toward your chest.
Quickly return your right foot to the starting position and simultaneously drive your left knee toward your chest.
Continue alternating legs at a fast, running-like pace.
Repeat for the desired duration or number of repetitions.

name: Mountain Pose - Mountain-To-Forward-Fold-Flow
cues: Stand tall in mountain pose with your feet together, arms by your sides, and weight evenly distributed.
Inhale and raise your arms overhead, lengthening your spine.
Exhale and hinge forward from your hips, sweeping your arms down as you fold toward the floor.
Allow your hands to reach toward the floor or rest on your shins, keeping a slight bend in your knees if needed.
Inhale to rise back up to mountain pose with arms overhead and repeat the flow for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Neck Half Circle
cues: Sit or stand with your spine tall and your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly drop your chin toward your chest.
Gently roll your head in a half arc from one shoulder toward the other, passing through the center.
Pause briefly on each side when your ear approaches your shoulder, feeling the stretch in your neck.
Return to center and repeat in the other direction for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Negative Pull Up
cues: Use a box or jump to reach the top position of a pull-up, with your chin above the bar and arms bent.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Slowly lower your body toward the starting hang position, taking 3-5 seconds to descend.
Maintain tension in your lats and arms throughout the descent, resisting gravity as much as possible.
Once fully extended, jump or step back to the top and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: One Arm Push Ups
cues: Begin in a wide push-up stance with one hand placed in the center of your chest and the other placed behind your back.
Engage your core tightly and keep your body in a rigid plank position.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending the working arm, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Pause briefly at the bottom, then press explosively back up to the starting position.
Complete the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.

name: Open Chest Triangle Pose Detail
cues: Stand with your feet wide apart, approximately three to four feet, and turn your right foot out 90 degrees.
Extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Hinge laterally over your front leg, lowering your right hand toward your right shin or the floor.
